newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: South Korea's Posco approves Venezuela HBI plant.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's Posco approves Venezuela HBI plant.

text.p: South Korea's Posco Chemical Co is to go ahead with a 1.5 million tonnes per year hot briquetted iron (HBI) plant in Venezuela in which it will have a controlling stake, the Venezuelan government said Monday.
Elias Nadim Ynaty, president of the Corporacion Venezolana de Guayana, was quoted in a release datelined Seoul, that Posco would invest about $240 million in the plant.
Posco is due to take a 55 percent stake in the plant with the CVG's Ferrominera del Orinoco taking another 15 percent and U.S. Raytheon Co 10 percent.
Korea's Dongbu Steel Co will take another 10 percent and Mexican Hylsa and Hyundai Metal Co Ltd five percent each.
"This investment by Posco is the first of a series of studies which they are making on other projects," in Venezuela, Ynaty said.
